# Data import 

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# CONFIGURATION --------------- 
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

base_dir <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/"

# Test directory 
list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

data <- data.frame()
data1 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_1.csv"))
#data2 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_2.csv"))
#data3 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_3.csv"))
data <- rbind(data, data1)
```

# Data manipulation

```{r}
# 1. Rename Q values 
data <- data %>% select(-q_value_pop2) # remove, and then decide if we need to 1-pop or now 

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    hybrid_status = case_when(
      str_detect(ind_id, "IND") ~ str_split_i(ind_id, "_", 2),
      str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC2HYB") ~ "BC2HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC3HYB") ~ "BC3HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC4HYB") ~ "BC4HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC5HYB") ~ "BC5HYB",
      str_detect(ind_id, "BC6HYB") ~ "BC6HYB"
    )
  )

# JC_orientation means pop1 == JC? -- doesn't necessary align with the BC2POP1 labels
data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    JC_orientation = mean(
      q_value_pop1[hybrid_status == "JC"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) > 0.5,
    
    JC = if_else(
      JC_orientation,
      q_value_pop1,
      1 - q_value_pop1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Cateogrical 
```{r}
# Factor order of the data/categorical variables 
data <- data %>%
  mutate(hybrid_status = factor(
    hybrid_status,
    levels = c("JA", "F1", "BC2HYB", "BC3HYB", "BC4HYB", "BC5HYB", "BC6HYB", "JC")
  ))

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    experiment_ID = factor(
      experiment_ID,
      levels = c(1), #, 2, 3),
      labels = c("on_all"), #, "on_JC", "on_JA")
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    bootstrap_ID = factor(bootstrap_ID)
  )
```

# Data validation
```{r}
# Combine both grouping variables inside a single group_by statement
summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarize(
    # mean_q_JA  = mean(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sd_q_JA    = sd(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_q_JC  = mean(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JC    = sd(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_runs = n(),
    .groups    = "drop" # This automatically ungroups the data after summarizing
  )
```

# Density plot with no JA and JC

```{r}
data_withminimized_JCJA <- data %>%
 # group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  filter(
    !hybrid_status %in% c("JA", "JC") #| row_number() <= 100
  ) #%>%
  #ungroup()

# Density plot - Overlaid distributions across experiments per hybrid status
q_density_plot <- ggplot(data_withminimized_JCJA, 
                         aes(x = JC, fill = hybrid_status, color = hybrid_status)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ experiment_ID, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Distribution of Q-values Across Experiments",
    x = "Q-value (1 = JC, 0 = JA)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Hybrid_status",
    color = "Hybrid_status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(q_density_plot)
```

```{r}
# ---
density_data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarise(
    density = list(density(JC, from = 0, to = 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(density) %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    JC_max_density = max(y[x %in% x[hybrid_status == "JC"]]),
    normalized_density = y / JC_max_density
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

# Box plot - everything 

```{r}
q_dist_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(experiment_ID, y = JC, fill = experiment_ID)) +
  # Draw boxplot to show median and IQR per experiment
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Overlay actual individual observations cleanly on top
  # geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  # Separate panels by hybrid class
  facet_wrap(~ hybrid_status, ncol=8) +
  # Corrected Labels
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of q-values across different loci",
    x = "Experiment ID", # Fixed axis label to match data
    y = "Q-value (1-JC, 0-JA)"
  ) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    #legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(q_dist_plot)
```

# Bar plot - everything 

```{r}
# Combine both grouping variables inside a single group_by statement
summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, hybrid_status) %>%
  summarize(
    # mean_q_JA  = mean(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    # sd_q_JA    = sd(JA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_q_JC  = mean(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_q_JC    = sd(JC, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_runs = n(),
    .groups    = "drop" # This automatically ungroups the data after summarizing
  )

print(summary_data)

# summary_data <- summary_data %>% filter(!hybrid_status %in% c("JC", "JA"))
q_dist_plot <- ggplot(summary_data, 
                      aes(x = experiment_ID, y = sd_q_JC, fill = experiment_ID)) +
  
  # Bar chart
  geom_col(alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Set y-axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.1)) +
  
  # Separate panels by hybrid class
  facet_wrap(~ hybrid_status, ncol = 8) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Comp. std. across different bootstrapping of all individuals, JC, JA",
    x = "Experiment ID",
    y = "Standard deviation of Q-value"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(q_dist_plot)
```

```{r}
  # Bar chart

print(q_dist_plot)


```

```{r}
summary_data_label <- summary_data %>% 
  filter(!hybrid_status %in% c("JC", "JA")) %>%
  mutate(
    color_group = case_when(
      experiment_ID %in% c("on_all", "on_JC", "on_JA") ~ "By population",
      experiment_ID %in% c("500_loci", "1000_loci", "5000_loci") ~ "By loci",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

q_dist_plot <- ggplot(summary_data_label, aes(x = experiment_ID, y = sd_q_JC, fill = color_group)) + 
  # Bar chart
  geom_col(alpha = 0.6) + 
  # Set y-axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.1)) + 
  # Separate panels by hybrid class
  facet_wrap(~ hybrid_status, ncol = 8) + 
  # Custom colors for the groups
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("By population" = "#2c7bb6", "By loci" = "#d7191c")) +
  labs(
    title = "Std across all experiments",
    x = "Experiment ID",
    y = "Standard deviation of Q-value",
    fill = "Experiment Category"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, size = 8, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(q_dist_plot)
```
